theme: Hangul Cards closed test — recruiting Android testers (DM Gmail used on Google Play)

threads.text:
Looking for Android testers 🙋

I made Hangul Cards — a free app for people just starting to read Korean. Flip the cards, watch the letters snap into a real syllable, and hear it in two native voices.

Google Play requires a closed test before launch. Want to join? DM me the Gmail address you use on Google Play and I'll add you and send the link.

Keep it installed for 14 days and tell me honestly what's confusing 🙏

Still looking for a few more Android testers for Hangul Cards 🙏

✔ Free, no sign-up, works offline
✔ For absolute beginners (가 → 각 → 닭)
✔ 14 days, Android only

DM me the Gmail address you use on Google Play and I'll send you the invite.

Beginners: what was the hardest part of learning Hangul?
